$comment: Editor-facing schema for the mock-e2e-server config file (mocks.json / MOCK_CONFIG_FILE). The runtime validation authority is validateMockDefinition in lib/validation.ts - this file steers authoring only and is deliberately looser where precision buys nothing in an editor (e.g. no wildcard-position rule for uri). Update both when mock fields change.
title: mock-e2e-server mock configuration
description: Either a bare array of mock definitions, or an object wrapper { "$schema": ..., "mocks": [...] } so the file can self-reference this schema for editor autocomplete.

method.description: HTTP method (the runtime also accepts lowercase).

uri.description: Path starting with "/"; may contain :param segments and a final * wildcard; must not target /_mocks.

headers.description: Response headers sent on every matched response.

body.description: Static response body: any JSON value. Strings are served as text/plain, everything else as application/json. Mutually exclusive with responseSchema.

bodySchema.description: JSON Schema applied to request bodies for this mock; failing bodies get 400 with per-violation details. The runtime rejects schemas it cannot compile.

responseSchema.description: JSON Schema (2019-09/2020-12) the response body is generated from on every call. Mutually exclusive with body.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor tooling; never resolved at runtime.
